senses.zh_definition: 若指意大利语游戏名称：一种双方同时伸出若干手指，并喊出所猜手指总数的游戏。输入词形是否取此义尚未确认。
senses.en_definition: If referring to the Italian game name: a game in which two players simultaneously display fingers and call out their predicted combined total; the input token's intended meaning remains unverified.
senses.ms_definition: Jika merujuk nama permainan Itali: permainan dua orang yang menunjukkan jari serentak sambil menyebut tekaan jumlah jari kedua-duanya; maksud bentuk dalam input belum dapat dipastikan.
senses.nuances: 这是外语名称的候选解释，并非已核实的 DBP 马来语释义。下列搭配和例句仅示范介绍该游戏时的用法，不代表已验证的高频马来语搭配。音节、马来语音标及爪夷文保留 null。[意大利语释义来源：Treccani](https://www.treccani.it/vocabolario/morra/)。

etymology.historical_story: Treccani describes morra as a very old Italian popular game and explicitly labels its etymology uncertain. Players show fingers simultaneously while calling a predicted total, combining quick calculation with anticipation. This documented Italian meaning provides a possible interpretation of the spelling, but it does not establish that the supplied token is an adopted Malay word. [Source: Treccani](https://www.treccani.it/vocabolario/morra/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 候选义记忆：看到 morra，想象两只手同时伸指、两个人同时报总数。马来语读音未核实，不编造谐音。
